general.title: General

cli.label: Command-line launcher
cli.hint: Install the `glimpse` command so you can open a repo from your terminal, like `code .`.
cli.restartHint: Restart your terminal, then run “glimpse .” in any repo.

autoFetch.label: Auto-fetch
autoFetch.hint: Periodically fetch from remotes in the background.

pullStrategy.label: Default pull strategy
pullStrategy.hint: Merge, rebase or fast-forward only when pulling.

gitIdentity.effectiveMissing: No identity resolves for this repository — a commit here would fail. Set one below.
gitIdentity.overrideHint: Override the identity for the current repository only.

enable.label: Sign commits
enable.hint: Sign new commits with your GPG or SSH key.

format.label: Signature format
format.hint: Use an OpenPGP (GPG) or an SSH key.

key.label: Signing key
key.hint: Key ID or path used to sign.

mode.label: Resolution
mode.hint: How glimpse runs git for this repository.

path.label: Git path
path.hint: Path to the git binary to use.

ssh.helperHint: Stores credentials for HTTPS remotes; SSH remotes use the keys below.
ssh.generated: SSH key generated and public key copied
ssh.hasKey: You already have an ed25519 key.
ssh.hint: Add a public key to your git host (GitHub/GitLab) to authenticate over SSH.

autoUpdate.label: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.hint: Check for updates on launch and install them automatically.

releaseChannel.label: Release channel
releaseChannel.hint: Stable, opt in to beta builds, or run an experiment.

experiment.label: Experiment
experiment.hint: A per-branch experimental build. Switching is manual.
experiment.switchHint: Install the selected experiment build (forced, not just newer).

general.checkUpdatesHint: Check for an update right now.

recentReposMax.label: Recent projects kept
recentReposMax.hint: How many recently opened repositories to remember.

recentReposOnPage.label: Recent projects on start screen
recentReposOnPage.hint: How many to list on the start screen (at most the number kept).

recentReposInSearch.label: Recent projects in search
recentReposInSearch.hint: How many to list in the command palette (at most the number kept).

recentActionsMax.label: Recent actions kept
recentActionsMax.hint: How many recently used commands to remember.

recentActionsInSearch.label: Recent actions in search
recentActionsInSearch.hint: How many to show under 'Recently used' (at most the number kept).

devMode.label: Developer mode
devMode.hint: Unlock developer tools — the Showcase and Triggers pages, plus the beta update channel.

experimentsOptIn.label: Participate in experiments
experimentsOptIn.hint: Opt in to per-branch experiment builds. Off by default; unlocks the Experiment release channel.

badges.label: Badges
badges.hint: Every badge variant at a glance.

toasts.label: Test toasts
toasts.hint: Fire one of each toast kind.

dialogs.label: Dialogs
dialogs.hint: Open the dialogs you don't normally see directly.

confirm.title: Delete branch?
confirm.description: A preview of the confirm dialog — nothing actually happens.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Choose how glimpse looks. System follows your OS.

fileView.label: File list view
fileView.hint: Flat list or grouped folder tree.

diffFont.label: Diff font size
diffFont.hint: Text size in the diff viewer.

sidebarEdit.label: Edit layout
sidebarEdit.hint: Reorder the sidebar sections by dragging. Each one can also be collapsed.

sidebarResizable.label: Resizable
sidebarResizable.hint: Drag the right edge to resize the sidebar.

shortenDependabot.label: Shorten Dependabot branches
shortenDependabot.hint: Collapse long dependabot/… branch names in the history graph.

searchLanguages.label: Additional search languages
searchLanguages.hint: Also match command palette entries in these languages, on top of the display language.

about.title: About
about.description: A lightweight, git-native desktop Git client — the full branch graph, diffs, and everyday git, with first-class WSL support.
